title: Bookmark Escape Hatch
user: People with years of browser and service bookmarks who need a reliable, inspectable export before changing tools or services.
smallest_useful_product: Local browser/CLI utility that imports HTML/JSON/CSV exports, normalizes URLs/tags/dates, detects duplicates and malformed records, produces a vendor-neutral archive plus a destination-specific dry-run report.
success_measure: For supported exports, 99% of valid input records round-trip through the neutral format, and the report identifies every unsupported field before import.
constraints: Process exports locally; avoid downloading protected article content; use documented formats; preserve source attribution and archive timestamps where present.
